transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
Ever since the car crash, it’s like the accident keeps replaying in my head when I’m awake and when I’m trying to relax, and I can’t shut it off. I just don't know what to do to make it stop.
Since the car crash, do you also avoid reminders of the accident, feel constantly on edge or easily startled, or have nightmares about it?

Yeah, I definitely avoid driving and make excuses to my family so I don't have to get in cars or go near that intersection. I also feel constantly tense and on edge, even when I'm just sitting at my desk or at church. And when I finally do fall asleep, I keep jerking awake from these half-dreams about screeching brakes, so I'm always exhausted.
